tool.help:
**Boltz-2: Structure Prediction via NVIDIA NIM API**
Predict biomolecular structures without local GPU using NVIDIA's cloud service.
**Saves ~103 GB disk space and 48+ GB GPU memory!**
**Capabilities:** - Protein structure prediction - Protein-ligand complexes - Binding affinity estimation - DNA/RNA structures
**API Key:** Get your key at https://build.nvidia.com/mit/boltz2
**Input Format (YAML):** ```yaml sequences: - protein: id: A sequence: MKFLILLFNILC... - ligand: id: B smiles: 'CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O' ```
**Citation:** Passaro et al. (2025). Boltz-2: Towards Accurate Binding Affinity Prediction. bioRxiv.
